projectDescription: Acme Corp's 18-month AWS migration project aims to optimize licensing costs and modernize their infrastructure as they exit their on-premises data center. The plan leverages AWS services to achieve a 3-year Next Unit of Computing (NUC) plan, maximizing efficiency and scalability. Key priorities include migrating workloads to the us-east-1 region, modernizing applications where feasible, and carefully managing licensing to reduce costs.
